head: 713b47d322f0674f154a70ec4baebd4566905d41
scope: Exactly church1 and maya1_9 at Mid512 and High1024 after the Quake mixed-codec transition. Carry forward source/canonical geometry/colour acceptance only under exact custody; review new actual decoded height and XYZ values, opposed lighting, material, BOX reductions, repeats and corners.
coordination: Root coordinator retains actual Bluey task ownership and storage-fallback record; this supervised helper makes no board ownership, integration or release mutation.
method: Read current AGENTS, owner standing instructions, Quake mission, shared standard and repository texture-authoring skill/workflow.

Verified every retained original/raw/prompt/master receipt/RGB/float-height/prior tier receipt against the exact prior ART review hashes. Verified descriptor master and prior tier receipt bindings and new tier receipt hashes.

Verified all four new diffuse WebP byte strings equal the prior qualified diffuse files, and verified every prior map still matches its sealed ART-review SHA256. Data maps changed as expected; measured decoded deltas are diagnostic only.

Viewed all four actual decoded diffuse images at full512/1024 dimensions, independently decoded all four height/combined XYZ sets and viewed full-resolution neutral opposed lighting from those decoded XYZ channels. Grey lighting normalizes the decoded vectors solely for visualization.

Viewed eight new coordinator-produced review/relief sheets, containing actual decoded diffuse opposed lighting and repeated tiles. Read review-builder source to confirm decoded map use and BOX reduction on both comparison inputs.
Independently reduced BOTH unchanged native128 and actual decoded Mid/High inputs to64 and32 using Pillow BOX, retained PNGs and viewed their nearest4x contact sheets.
Viewed exact1:1 diffuse X/Y seam strips and four-tile corner crosses, plus new height/XYZ/grey representative X/Y seam strips and four-corner crosses at each tier.

Reused the prior visually classified physical stone/joint rectangles only as spatial sampling locations, rescaled from master1024; recomputed all decoded8-bit scalar statistics on the new actual lossless maps. Physical acceptance is visual, not a numerical threshold.

carryForward.scope: Prior native/source/material-plan/master RGB/canonical float-relief geometry and unchanged colour-map acceptance. This does not carry forward the affected decoded height/XYZ acceptance without review.

materialAt1to1.observation: Actual decoded pale warm-grey limestone remains recognisable: irregular pits, chips, weathering and broad diagonal fracture faces at this full tier size. The colour bytes are unchanged; no new abstract grain or colour-compression injury is introduced.

nativeHalfAndQuarter.filter: Pillow Resampling.BOX on BOTH original128 and actual decoded replacement; nearest4x display only
nativeHalfAndQuarter.observation: At64/32, both inputs reduced with BOX retain two courses, upper central and lower quarter-width joints, diagonal face marks and warm light/dark relationships. The inherited mildly lighter/smoother replacement remains representative of native colour/forms/scale.

repeatAndFourCorners.observation: Horizontal mortar remains the intended Y repeat. The X wrap crosses stone faces with the previously accepted native-derived diagonal detail discontinuity; it is still visible and has not been hidden by an invented joint, block or perimeter frame. Fresh height/XYZ seam/corner views introduce no new boundary feature.

freshDecodedHeightAndXYZ.observation: New decoded lossless height retains low vertical and horizontal joint cores against both neighboring stone faces. The broad fracture relief and pores remain face structure; no face/joint inversion or separately raised pigment motif appears. New XYZ retains joint shoulders and directionally coherent face variation.

freshOpposedLighting.observation: Viewed both decoded-XYZ neutral-grey light directions at exact tier dimensions and both actual diffuse lighting panels. Joint-side highlights reverse with light direction while joint cores remain recessed relative to rough stone faces. Relief has a strong directional surface response, but the combined material remains readable stone; the codec transition introduces no new band, block edge or material inversion. This is offline art review, not runtime shader acceptance.

remainingBoundaries: city8_2, rock3_2 and wwall1_1 remain ART-HOLD; this review neither inspects nor promotes them.
Other earlier HOLDs and all separate Hexen work remain outside this review.
Independent public pipeline/codec math verification is bound as a separate result; this reviewer did not rerun the complete public verifier.
